text: I just became mayor of the worst town on the internet.
And you decide what happens to it.
This is Dustbury. Population: three.
The fountain hasn't worked in years. Now it's just a puddle with ambitions.
The streetlights? Every single one is dead.
And the town hall... Honestly, I work in a tent.
But Dustbury still has people. Three of them.
Old Rose has lived here for eighty years.
Gary sleeps at the bus stop. The bus stopped coming years ago.
And Dot. Nobody knows where Dot came from.
Oh, and that building on the hill? Nobody goes in there.
We'll get to that.
Here's the problem. Rose says if nothing changes, she's leaving.
And if Dustbury hits zero, it's gone. Forever.
We have one hundred coins. Enough to fix one thing.
Option A: fix the fountain. Clean water, and maybe, a new neighbor.
Option B: fix the streetlights, so Gary isn't sleeping in the dark.
Comment A or B, and tell me why. The best reason gets a shout-out next episode.
Follow, to see what you built. Or what you broke.
Welcome to Dustbury.
